correctness.rationale: Exact Parseval gives M_n(s). The rational radial modulus maximum yields log M_n(s)=nF(s)+O(log n), with F(s)=Us+cs^3+O(s^5), c=U(U^2-1)/48. The concave tangent at Un bounds the weighted square norm above. Two Chernoff estimates on the tilted coefficient law concentrate K within O(ns^2), where the deficit is O(n^theta s^4), strictly smaller than ns^3 for theta<1. Since ns^3 tends to infinity precisely for theta>2/3, the claimed correction and its remainder follow with correct norm-square normalization. All quantifiers and boundaries are explicit in RESULT.md.
